Calculation: = PM/overhead + Referral/transfer + Service delivery + Labor + Equipment
= Referral Recurrent + Transfer Recurrent + Referral Capital + Transfer Capital
= Surgical Labor + Nurse Labor + Anesthetist Labor
= Infrastructure + General Equipment + Doppler + CTG + POCUS
= Baseline Maternal DALYs - Intervention Maternal DALYs
= Baseline Neonatal DALYs - Intervention Neonatal DALYs
= Maternal DALYs averted + Neonatal DALYs averted
= Mean Total Discounted Cost / Mean Maternal DALYs Averted
= Mean Total Discounted Cost / Mean Total DALYs Averted
= Number of POCUS Units x $5,000 x Annualization Factor
= num_L2/3 + num_L4 + num_L5 from county parameters
= Capital cost x annuity factor using useful life and 3% discount rate
= Added units or capacity x unit cost x annuity factor using useful life and 3% discount rate
